CVE-2026-116738.title: VMime through 0.9.2 contains an integer underflow in the uuEncode ...
CVE-2026-116738.description: VMime through 0.9.2 contains an integer underflow in the uuEncoder::decode function that allows remote attackers to trigger a stack-based buffer overflow via crafted uuencoded MIME parts. Attackers can send an email with a uuencoded line whose length character is 'b' but is not a 'begin' line, corrupting stack memory to crash the application or potentially execute code.

CVE-2026-116739.title: VMime through 0.9.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerabil ...
CVE-2026-116739.description: VMime through 0.9.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the uuEncoder::decode function that writes uninitialized stack memory into decoded output for over-long lines. Attackers can send a crafted uuencode or x-uuencode MIME part with a large line length byte to leak up to 15 bytes of stack contents per line in decoded attachments.
